bio.overview: James LaBrie is one of the most recognizable and highly acclaimed vocalists in the progressive rock and metal world, best known as the powerful and dynamic voice of Dream Theater.
extended_bio: Born on May 5, 1963, in Penetanguishene, Ontario, Canada, LaBrie began his musical career in various local bands before joining Dream Theater in 1991.
Known for his wide vocal range and emotional delivery, LaBrie has contributed to all Dream Theater albums from Images and Words (1992) to the present.
Has released several solo albums and collaborated with other artists including Trent Gardner and Matt Guillory.

trivia.did_you_know: James LaBrie survived a serious vocal cord injury in 1994 through intensive therapy and retraining of his singing technique.
